# Astronomical 0.2.35
Stable macOS release for Apple Silicon.
## Changes
- The Library catalog offers Laguna XS 2.1 at 6-bit, 5-bit, and 4-bit. - Laguna persistent prompt-cache restore is lossless for a repeated prompt. - Decode keeps routed experts and seated complete expert layers under a squeezed memory ceiling instead of dropping a whole layer. - When a Metal kernel is demoted, serving still produces valid output on the public MLX path.
## Compatibility
Existing configuration, Library downloads, and prompt-cache files remain in place. macOS 14.0 or later on Apple Silicon is required.
This build is Developer ID signed and notarized. Sparkle verifies the update feed and the disk image before installation.
